detailZh: 奥利弗·贝尔曼锁定哈斯F1席位，2027赛季车手阵容正式确定
随着哈斯确认已与奥利弗·贝尔曼就第三个赛季达成协议，2027赛季F1车手阵容已经确定
奥利弗·贝尔曼与哈斯最终签下新合同，将正式在2027赛季F1继续留在哈斯。
周四，哈斯宣布贝尔曼将在明年留队，与巴西新秀拉斐尔·卡马拉搭档。
法拉利青训车手贝尔曼原本就注定会留在美国所有的这支车队，过去两个赛季他一直以租借形式从法拉利车队来到这里。
但在他即将迎来效力该车队的第三个年头之际，贝尔曼的团队也希望获得关于他长期未来的某些保证。而在过去两年成为哈斯车队的头号车手、表现优于如今已被弃用的埃斯特班·奥康，并将在明年搭档新秀卡马拉之后，据信贝尔曼的团队也在寻求大幅加薪。
在上周的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，贝尔曼承认他“相当失望”，因为“我坐在这里参加第20站比赛，却还没有签下明年的合同。这一直是个奇怪的局面，但我们正在取得进展。”
在哈斯车队力争抵挡奥迪、争夺年度第七名的战斗中，贝尔曼为车队拿下了30分中的23分。
detailEn: Oliver Bearman locks in Haas F1 seat as 2027 grid officially set
The 2027 Formula 1 grid is set as Haas confirms it has reached an agreement with Oliver Bearman for a third season
Oliver Bearman will officially stay at Haas for the 2027 F1 season after he and the team finally put pen to paper on a new deal.
On Thursday Haas announced Bearman would stay put for next year, partnering Brazilian rookie Rafael Camara at the squad.
Ferrari protege Bearman was always going to stay with the US-owned team, which has had him on loan from the Scuderia for the past two seasons.

But as he is set for his third year with the squad, Bearman's camp also wanted some assurances about his long-term future. And having become Haas' lead driver over the past two years, outperforming the now ousted Esteban Ocon and partnering a rookie in Camara next year, Bearman's camp is also believed to look for a significant pay increase.

At last week's Las Vegas Grand Prix, Bearman admitted he was "quite disappointed" that "I'm sitting here at round 20 without a contract signed for next year. It's been a strange situation, but we're getting there."
Bearman scored 23 of Haas' 30 points as the squad aims to hold off Audi in the fight for seventh in the championship.

items.titleZh: 卡塔尔大奖赛F1车手面临2026赛季最高胎压要求
items.summaryZh: 在卡塔尔大奖赛上，F1车手将面对2026赛季最高的最低前轮胎压，这也是赛事周末开始前有史以来的最高规定值。
items.originalTitle: F1 drivers face highest tyre pressure orders yet in Qatar
items.summaryEn: At the Qatar Grand Prix, F1 drivers will face the highest minimum front tyre pressures of the 2026 season, the highest ever stipulated at the start of a race weekend.
detailZh: 在卡塔尔大奖赛上，F1车手将面对2026赛季最高的最低前轮胎压，这也是赛事周末开始前有史以来的最高规定值。
卢赛尔赛道的独特特征——包括连续高速弯和激进的 pyramid 式路肩——使其成为对轮胎最具挑战性的赛道之一。
这是赛季横向能量最高的赛道之一，高速右弯偏多意味着左前胎承受特别大的压力。
倍耐力历来在卡塔尔采用三种手段来降低轮胎故障风险：带来最硬配方、提高最低胎压，以及规定最长 stint 长度，使每套轮胎不会被用到寿命尽头。
今年，三项响应参数再次被采集，且压力相比去年略有上调。
在国际汽联于卡塔尔大奖赛周末前发送给车队的官方通知中，前轮最低胎压设定为29psi，而后轮则设定为27.5psi。
对前轮而言，这是全年最高值，此前的基准为28psi——该数值是在铃鹿、银石和斯帕设定的。
对后轮而言，卡塔尔的数值比去年赛前规定高出4psi，但并非2026年的峰值。斯帕和拉斯维加斯均为28.0psi。
在2025年卡塔尔大奖赛上，倍耐力在进入比赛周末时设定的最低前胎压为28psi，但在周五练习后发现轮胎橡胶出现割伤，于是将胎压提高到29psi——他们认为这是赛车碾过被带上赛道的碎石所致。
这一次是否需要在比赛周末期间做出类似调整的可能性不能被排除，尤其是因为2026款赛车在主动空气动力学下的表现只有在赛道活动开始后才会变得清晰。
本赛季最低胎压上升的原因之一，是倍耐力不得不防范直线模式失效的风险——一旦失效，将在直道上给轮胎施加巨大负荷。
这使得后胎最低胎压被提高，产生了明显变化，在卡塔尔也不例外：去年的基准值为23.5周五后提高到24，如今则设定为27.5psi。
卡塔尔赛道的挑战性极高，因此倍耐力为确保安全裕度足够大，一个可选方案就是将最低胎压大幅提高。
然而，这并非车手和车队所乐见的——今年已经出现抱怨，认为胎压总体上最终被设得过高。
因此，尽管今年光头胎的结构更为坚固，且下压力水平总体更低，倍耐力仍选择再次对轮胎实施最长使用圈数限制。
该限制被设定为每套轮胎最多使用27圈——比去年的规定多出两圈。
威廉姆斯车队现场工程师保罗·威廉姆斯表示，赛道特性和轮胎限制让车队面临的情况远非简单直接。
关于排位赛，他说：“软胎并不是一个明确的首次计时圈轮胎。右前轮难以升温，而左前轮和左后轮在整圈中会过热，因此我们预计出场圈需要艰难地暖胎，并需要两圈冷却圈来重置后轮温度。”
然后，关于正赛本身，他解释道：“左前轮将成为限制因素，先是过热，然后是磨损，而后轮磨损相对较低。软胎存在左前轮颗粒化风险，而中性胎预计仍会出现高磨损。”
很可能中性胎和硬胎将成为首选的正赛轮胎，最少两次进站的比赛意味着主要策略挑战是确保最后一次进站不会太早，以免造成代价高昂的额外换胎。
迈凯伦赛车工程副总监阿德里安·古德温表示：“固定的 赛段长度实际上让轮胎管理变得更简单，因为我们不需要在轮胎寿命结束后继续管理它们。
“主要的策略要点是不要过早进站，以免被迫采用三次进站的比赛策略。”
detailEn: Formula 1 drivers are to face the highest minimum front tyre pressures of the 2026 season - and the highest ever stipulated at the start of a race weekend - at the Qatar Grand Prix.
The unique characteristics of the Lusail circuit, which features sequences of high-speed corners and aggressive pyramid-style kerbs, makes it one of the most challenging for tyres.
It is one of the highest lateral-energy circuits of the season, with the bias of fast right handers meaning the front left is punished particularly hard.

Pirelli has historically used three techniques to minimise the risk of tyre failures in Qatar: bringing its hardest compounds, increasing the minimum pressures, and imposing maximum stint lengths so each set is not taken right to the end of its life.
This year, all three responses have been taken again, with pressures nudged up compared to last year.
In the official FIA notes sent to teams ahead of the Qatar weekend, the front minimum tyre pressure is set at 29psi, while the rears have been set at 27.5psi.
For the fronts this is the highest of the year, with the previous benchmark having been set at 28psi – which was laid down at Suzuka, Silverstone and Spa.
For the rears, the Qatar number is four psi higher than the pre-weekend stipulation last year but not a peak for 2026. Spa and Las Vegas were both at 28.0 psi.

At the 2025 Qatar GP, Pirelli headed into the weekend with a minimum front pressure of 28psi but then lifted it to 29psi when it discovered cuts in the rubber after Friday running – which it believed had been caused by cars running over gravel that had been pulled onto the track.

The possibility of a similar in-weekend response being needed this time around cannot be ruled out, especially because the behaviour of the 2026 cars with active aero will only become clear once track action has got underway.

One of the reasons minimum tyre pressures have gone up this season is because Pirelli has had to counter the risks of straight mode failures – which would have the consequence of putting huge forces through tyres on the straights.

This has made a notable difference with the minimum pressures at the rear being lifted and it is no different in Qatar with last year's baseline of 23.5psi (lifted to 24.5psi after Friday) now being set at 27.5psi.
The challenge of Qatar is so high that one option for Pirelli to be satisfied that safety margins are big enough would be to lift the minimum pressures much higher.
However, this is not something drivers and teams are keen on – with complaints having already surfaced this year about how high pressures have generally ended up.
So that is why, despite a more robust construction of slick tyre this year, plus downforce levels generally being less, Pirelli has elected to impose a maximum stint length for tyres once again.
This has been set at 27 laps for a set of tyres – which is two more than was put in place last year.
The nature of the track and the tyre limits make things far from straightforward for teams, according to Williams chief trackside engineer Paul Williams.

For qualifying he said: "The soft is not a clear first-timed-lap tyre. The front-right struggles to warm up while the front-left and rear-left overheat through the lap, so we expect a hard out-lap for warm-up and a double cool-down lap to reset the rear temperatures."

Then, for the race itself, he explained: "The front-left will be the limit, first through overheating and then through wear, while rear wear is relatively low. The soft carries a front-left graining risk and the medium is still expected to see high wear."

The likelihood is that the medium and hard will be the preferred race tyres, with the minimum two-stop race meaning the main strategy challenge is making sure that the final stops do not come too early that a costly extra change is created.
McLaren's associate director of car race engineering Adrian Goodwin said: "The fixed stint lengths actually make it a simpler event for tyres, as we're not trying to manage them beyond end of life.
"The main strategic point is not stopping so early that you're forced into a three-stop race."

在 stewards 对车队中的某位车手进行处罚时，一级方程式车队老板通常会迅速采取措施减轻打击。但在2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛中，查尔斯·勒克莱尔在7号弯道撞上刘易斯·汉密尔顿导致其失控后，法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔采取了相反的做法——支持国际汽联的裁决，并明确表示责任所在。
在内华达州度过的一个受伤的夜晚后，F1电视采访了瓦瑟尔，直接问他是否只有勒克莱尔一个人违反了团队指令，还是两位车手在争夺第六名的激烈战斗中都负有责任。
“不，我认为……国际汽联的决定非常明确，”瓦瑟尔回答道。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利
裁判的官方判决几乎没有留下任何解释的空间。根据国际体育条例附录L，第四章，第二条第d）款，裁判在文件60中指出，16号赛车在7号弯从44号赛车相当远的后方发起了内侧切入。
应用FIA驾驶标准指南，官员判定勒克莱尔的前轴在弯顶处至少没有与汉密尔顿的镜子并排 - 结论是勒克莱尔"没有获得在7号弯的权利，并对由此产生的碰撞负有全部责任"。
由此产生的10秒时间处罚使勒克莱尔在终点线时降至第10位，而汉密尔顿恢复到第7位 - 这使得法拉利从原本在发车线上排名第10和第11的赛车中冲入领先集团，却只得到了微薄的一分。
瓦瑟尔："我们又一次摧毁了比赛"
让瓦瑟尔最恼火的不只是失去的分数，还有时机。就在墨西哥城第一圈发生纠缠后的三周后，就在法拉利的维修区在五圈前通过无线电向勒克莱尔发出警告后不久，同样的故障再次发生。
“我知道他已经道歉了，我知道他很抱歉，但今天我们又一次摧毁了比赛，我们本可以做得更好，”瓦瑟尔说。 “我不知道比赛的结果会怎样，因为比赛非常混乱，但我们不能像这样丢分。而且，不仅仅是分数，还有每个人的动力，工作的回报，努力的回报，这对我是巨大的挫折。”
瓦瑟尔没有浪费任何时间来表达他的愤怒，在冷却圈期间打破车队无线电，首先召唤勒克莱尔。在之后接受F1电视采访时，他确认了最初的会议已经举行，同时暗示在情绪冷却后会有进一步的谈话。 “我已经和查尔斯今晚讨论过了，但现在我最好消化我的挫折，”他补充道。
后来在拉斯维加斯面对书面媒体时，瓦瑟尔澄清了第一次遭遇有多么直率：“那不是讨论。我只是说了。” 他拒绝了在尾流严重的比赛中实施严格车队指令的呼吁，他认为问题归结于基本的专业性：“这不是规则的问题。你能做些什么不同的事情，除了你必须尊重你的队友？”
detailEn: Fred Vasseur backs FIA ruling after Charles Leclerc's Las Vegas clash with Lewis Hamilton
Fred Vasseur backs the FIA's "quite clear" penalty blaming Charles Leclerc for spinning Lewis Hamilton in Las Vegas
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Formula 1 team bosses usually rush to soften the blow when stewards penalise one of their drivers. After Charles Leclerc clipped Lewis Hamilton into a spin at Turn 7 during the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur took the opposite approach - endorsing the FIA’s ruling and leaving no doubt over where responsibility lay.

Speaking to F1 TV after a bruised night in Nevada, Vasseur was asked directly whether Leclerc alone had defied team instructions or if both drivers shared fault in their heated battle for sixth place.
"No, I think... the decision of the FIA was quite clear," Vasseur answered.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari

The stewards’ official verdict left equally little room for interpretation. Reviewing video and onboard footage under Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the International Sporting Code, the stewards noted in Document 60 that Car 16 launched its inside lunge at Turn 7 from a considerable distance behind Car 44.

Applying the FIA Driving Standards Guidelines, officials determined Leclerc’s front axle was not at least alongside Hamilton’s mirror at the apex - concluding Leclerc "had not earned the right to the corner at Turn 7 and was wholly to blame for the resulting collision".

The resulting 10-second time penalty dropped Leclerc to 10th at the flag, while Hamilton recovered to seventh - leaving Ferrari with a meagre point return from a race where both cars had surged into the lead pack from 10th and 11th on the grid.
Vasseur: “Once again we destroyed the race”

What aggravated Vasseur most was not just the lost points, but the timing. Just three weeks after clear-the-air talks following their Lap 1 tangle in Mexico City - and moments after Ferrari’s pitwall had radioed a warning to Leclerc five corners prior - the same breakdown repeated itself.

"I know that he apologised, I know that he was sorry, but once again we destroyed the race today, that we could have done much better," Vasseur said. "I don't know what could be the outcome of the race because it was quite chaotic, but we can't lose points like this. And more than points, it's the motivation of everybody, the reward of the job done, the reward of the effort, and this - it's a huge frustration for me."

Vasseur wasted zero time making his anger felt, breaking onto team radio during the cooldown lap to summon Leclerc "before anything else". Speaking to F1 TV afterwards, he confirmed the initial meeting had already taken place while hinting further talks would follow once emotions cooled. "I already had the discussion with Charles tonight, but now it's better for me to digest my frustration," he added.

Later addressing written media in Las Vegas, Vasseur clarified just how blunt that first encounter had been: "It was not a discussion. I spoke." Rejecting calls to impose strict team orders in a slipstream-heavy race, he argued the issue came down to basic professionalism: "It's not a matter of rules. What can you do differently, except that you have to respect your team-mates?"

detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格将乔治·罗素排除在2027年F1冠军争夺之外：“自己挖了一个心理陷阱”
尼科·罗斯伯格将乔治·罗素排除在他的2027年F1冠军热门之外，警告这位梅赛德斯车手挖了一个"心理陷阱"
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说。这里有来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
乔治·罗素进入2026年Formula 1赛季时，看起来像是梅赛德斯无可争议的领导者。九个月之后，前银箭世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格甚至不认为这位28岁的车手是下赛季的冠军争夺者。
德国媒体Sport Bild采访中，罗斯伯格预测2027年拉塞尔不会出现快速反弹——将卫冕冠军安东内利、维斯塔潘、诺里斯，甚至法拉利的困顿搭档汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔排在拉塞尔之前。
将拉塞尔排除在这个名单之外，罗斯伯格承认这在纸面上听起来“有些疯狂”。然而，对于41岁的罗斯伯格来说，看着一个青少年掌控车队的心理冲击留下了深刻的印记。
罗斯伯格说，拉塞尔“自己挖了一个心理的坑”。“他想着：‘我现在是F1的国王，我正在统治这个赛季。’然后这个年轻的车手出现了，去年他几乎要离开F1，但他统治得如此之好，以至于乔治再也没有机会了。从那么高的地方跌落到地下室，心理上非常困难。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·安东内利，梅赛德斯
这场逆转在任何标准下都十分剧烈。在2025年，拉塞尔轻松地处理了他的新晋队友，在排位赛和大奖赛中都以21-3的成绩击败安东内利，总积分以319分对150分的优势领先。当拉塞尔在2026年从杆位起步，在墨尔本赢得比赛时，这看起来像是冠军争夺战的自然开端。
然而，整个赛季完全逆转。经过21轮比赛，安东内利以402分，9个胜利和16个领奖台成绩结束赛季——在墨西哥城已经锁定了车手冠军——而拉塞尔落后138分，以264分结束赛季，有3个胜利（澳大利亚、奥地利和阿塞拜疆）和8个领奖台成绩。
六场比赛没有领奖台——以及代价高昂的拉斯维加斯失误。
拉塞尔赛季末期的下滑使得对他的审视更加严格。自从9月底在巴库从杆位赢得比赛以来，他已经连续六场大奖赛没有领奖台——这是一段艰难的时期，包括在马来西亚退赛、在新加坡排名第九、在奥斯汀排名第八、在墨西哥城排名第六和在圣保罗排名第四。
拉斯维加斯带来了又一次痛苦的挫折。在拉斯维加斯大道上从第二位起步，并坚定地保持在领先集团中，拉塞尔在48圈时在5号弯道锁死在护栏上，与安东内利搏斗——在终点线前跌落到第九位，而维斯塔潘夺得了胜利。
在拉斯维加斯之前，拉塞尔就坦率地谈到了这一年对他有多大的压力。在安东内利在墨西哥夺冠后，这位英国人承认2026年是"我职业生涯中第一个坏日子比好日子多的完整赛季"。
"这很难处理吗？是的，非常难，"拉塞尔在11月写道。"每周都要振作起来很难吗？是的，非常难。有时会感到困惑？经常。我所知道的是，我已经全力以赴，2026年本不属于我。
车队负责人托托·沃尔夫将问题归咎于机械而不是心态，在奥斯汀之后指责梅赛德斯W17的"操作窗口"很窄，并指出车队必须扩大这个甜点区域，以便拉塞尔能够提取出稳定的速度。在赛季末段之前，拉塞尔语气更加坚定，坚持自己"没有遗憾"，并准备"比任何人都要多"来解决汽车的怪癖。
与安东内利一起在2027年已经锁定梅赛德斯车队的席位，拉塞尔目前并不面临立即的合同风险。然而，在11月27日至29日的卡塔尔（Qatar）和12月4日至6日的阿布扎比（Abu Dhabi）的比赛中，他与诺里斯（诺里斯）积分相同，均为264分，并且仅比汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）少3分，位居第三。在最后两个周末取得强劲的收官表现，将是他首次有机会证明罗斯伯格（Rosberg）的悲观预测是错误的。
detailEn: Nico Rosberg rules George Russell out of 2027 F1 title fight: “Dug himself into a mental hole”
Nico Rosberg leaves George Russell out of his 2027 F1 title favorites, warning the Mercedes star dug a "mental hole"
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

George Russell entered the 2026 Formula 1 campaign looking every bit like Mercedes’ undisputed leader. Nine months later, former Silver Arrows world champion Nico Rosberg does not even consider the 28-year-old a championship contender for next season.

Speaking to German outlet Sport Bild, Rosberg predicted no quick rebound for Russell in 2027 - placing defending champion Kimi Antonelli, Max Verstappen, Lando Norris, and even Ferrari’s embattled pairing of Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc ahead of him in the title pecking order.

Leaving Russell off that list was something Rosberg admitted sounds "somehow crazy" on paper. Yet to the 41-year-old, the psychological whiplash of watching a teenager seize control of the garage has left a deep mark.

Russell has "dug himself into a mental hole," Rosberg said. "He thought: 'I am now the king of Formula 1, I'm dominating the season.' And then this young driver comes along, who was almost on his way out of Formula 1 last year, and dominates so much that George doesn't stand a chance anymore. Going from so high up down into the basement like that is mentally extremely hard."
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

That reversal was sharp by any measure. In 2025, Russell handled his rookie team-mate with ease, beating Antonelli 21–3 in both qualifying and grands prix while outscoring him 319 points to 150. When Russell opened 2026 from pole with a Melbourne win, it looked like the natural start of a title charge.

Instead, the campaign flipped completely. Through 21 rounds, Antonelli sits on 402 points with nine victories and 16 podiums - having already sealed the drivers’ title in Mexico City - while Russell trails by 138 points on 264 with three wins (Australia, Austria, and Azerbaijan) and eight podiums.
Six races without a podium - and a costly Las Vegas lapse

Russell’s late-season slide has only sharpened the scrutiny. Since winning from pole in Baku in late September, he has gone six consecutive grands prix without a podium - a rough stretch featuring a retirement in Malaysia, ninth in Singapore, eighth in Austin, sixth in Mexico City, and fourth in Sao Paulo.

Las Vegas brought another painful setback. Starting second on the Strip and running firmly in the lead pack, Russell locked up into the Turn 5 barrier on Lap 48 while fighting Antonelli - tumbling to ninth at the chequered flag as Verstappen claimed victory.

Even before Las Vegas, Russell was candid about how heavily the year had weighed on him. Reflecting after Antonelli clinched the crown in Mexico, the Briton admitted 2026 marked "the first proper season of my career where I've had more bad days than good".

"Has it been tough to deal with? Yes, very," Russell wrote in November. "Has it been tough to pick myself up week in, week out? Yes, very. Confusion at times? Often. All I know is that I've given it my all and 2026 was not meant to be my year."

Team principal Toto Wolff has pointed to machinery rather than mindset, blaming the Mercedes W17’s narrow "operational window" after Austin and noting the squad must widen that sweet spot so Russell can extract consistent pace. Russell himself struck a firmer tone ahead of the run-in, insisting he carries "no regrets" and prepared "more than anybody" to solve the car’s quirks.

With his Mercedes seat already secured for 2027 alongside Antonelli, Russell does not face immediate contract jeopardy. Still, entering Qatar (27-29 November) and Abu Dhabi (4-6 December) tied with Norris on 264 points - and just three shy of Hamilton for third overall - a strong finish over the final two weekends gives him his first chance to prove Rosberg’s bleak forecast wrong.

items.summaryEn: Ralf Schumacher believes Lewis Hamilton is trying to mentally break Charles Leclerc after their Las Vegas Grand Prix clash, echoing the "mind games" once seen between Hamilton and Nico Rosberg.
detailZh: 拉尔夫·舒马赫认为，拉斯维加斯大奖赛之后，汉密尔顿对勒克莱尔的举动让人想起当年汉密尔顿与罗斯伯格之间的“心理战”。
拉尔夫·舒马赫指责汉密尔顿在拉斯维加斯大奖赛的碰撞后试图在心理上击垮勒克莱尔。
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析和比赛反应。
赛事干事和法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔将法拉利最近这次队内碰撞的责任归于夏尔·勒克莱尔。但前F1车手拉尔夫·舒马赫认为，马拉内罗真正的权力博弈来自车库的另一侧。
在接受德国天空体育《Backstage Boxengasse》播客采访时（据德国媒体sport.de报道），这位51岁的评论员对刘易斯·汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛7号弯末段纠缠后不断升级的摩擦给出了直率的评判。
“刘易斯·汉密尔顿完全是在压制查尔斯·勒克莱尔，”舒马赫说。“他想不惜一切代价夺取一号车手的权力。他想让勒克莱尔受到打击——他想在心理上摧毁他。”
从纸面上看，拉斯维加斯的情况似乎一目了然。勒克莱尔在7号弯从内线冲向汉密尔顿，撞到队友导致其打转，并因此被罚10秒，名次跌至第10，而汉密尔顿则恢复到第七——这促使瓦塞尔在赛后立即召见了这位摩纳哥车手。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
尽管舒马赫同意勒克莱尔犯了主要错误，但他认为汉密尔顿在让碰撞发生方面扮演了精心算计的角色。
“仔细观察可以发现，汉密尔顿没有让行，还假装没注意到勒克莱尔，”舒马赫说。“我认为那是故意的，因为比赛对他来说已经结束了。”
舒马赫还看到了汉密尔顿与尼科·罗斯伯格在梅赛德斯争冠时的影子——在德国被称为“星球大战”时代——那在2014年斯帕以及2016年西班牙和奥地利再度升级为碰撞。
“尼科·罗斯伯格至今也乐此不疲地谈论这些心理战，”舒马赫补充道。“这说明今年对他们两人造成了什么影响。”
为何法拉利2026年的转变引发了关于车队内部层级关系的争论
舒马赫的警告发出之际，围场内正日益激烈地争论：在墨西哥城和拉斯维加斯的三轮比赛中车手两次发生冲突后，法拉利是否必须确立明确的队内顺位。1996年世界冠军达蒙·希尔在社交媒体上敦促马拉内罗公开支持汉密尔顿作为其头号车手后，汉密尔顿在内华达州直接予以反驳。
“我从未要求过成为一号车手。我真的从来没有提过，”汉密尔顿对记者说。不过，他承认在2026年早些时候——当时他在巴塞罗那-加泰罗尼亚大奖赛的胜利使他在积分上领先勒克莱尔40分，成为最接近安东内利的挑战者——在赞德沃特等分站获得车队支持本可以帮助法拉利对抗梅赛德斯，并补充说队友相撞“本就不该发生”。
法拉利内部竞争力的变化有助于解释为何紧张情绪加剧。在2025年身披红色战袍的首个赛季中大幅落后于勒克莱尔（156分对242分）之后，汉密尔顿在第二个法拉利赛季的最后两轮比赛前领先队友17分（267分对250分）。
两位车手在2026年各获得一场大奖赛胜利——汉密尔顿在巴塞罗那，勒克莱尔在银石——汉密尔顿以七比六的领奖台数略占优势，并在墨西哥城为法拉利拿下唯一一个杆位，而勒克莱尔在21个共同参赛的分站中仍以13比8领先排位赛交锋。
勒克莱尔对他在拉斯维加斯的罚时承担全部责任，并承认"为车队感到相当尴尬"，而汉密尔顿坚称他一直只专注于追赶迈凯伦，而不是与队友缠斗。
随着卡塔尔大奖赛于周五（11月27日至29日）开赛，下周将在阿布扎比（12月4日至6日）迎来收官战，法拉利几乎没有时间证明其明星车手组合能够共存而不互相毁掉彼此的比赛。
detailEn: Ralf Schumacher sees echoes of Lewis Hamilton's Nico Rosberg "mind games" after Las Vegas
Ralf Schumacher accuses Lewis Hamilton of trying to mentally break Charles Leclerc after their Las Vegas GP clash
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Stewards and Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur placed the blame for the Scuderia’s latest intra-team collision on Charles Leclerc. Former Formula 1 driver Ralf Schumacher, however, believes the real power play at Maranello is coming from the other side of the garage.

Speaking on Sky Sports Germany’s Backstage Boxengasse podcast, as reported by German outlet sport.de, the 51-year-old analyst delivered a blunt verdict on the escalating friction between Lewis Hamilton and Leclerc following their late Turn 7 tangle at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

"Lewis Hamilton is completely showing up Charles Leclerc," Schumacher said. "He wants to seize number one power by any means necessary. He wants Leclerc to take a hit - he wants to mentally destroy him."

On paper, Las Vegas looked cut-and-dried. Leclerc lunged down Hamilton’s inside at Turn 7, clipped his team-mate into a spin, and took a 10-second time penalty that dropped him to 10th while Hamilton recovered to seventh - prompting Vasseur to summon the Monegasque driver immediately afterwards.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
While Schumacher agreed that Leclerc committed the main mistake, he argued Hamilton played a calculated role in letting the contact happen.

"Upon closer inspection, you can see that Hamilton did not give way and pretended not to have noticed Leclerc," Schumacher said. "I assume that was intentional, because the race was already over for him."

Schumacher also saw echoes of Hamilton’s Mercedes championship battles with Nico Rosberg - known in Germany as the "Star Wars" era - which boiled over into collisions at Spa in 2014 and again in Spain and Austria in 2016.
"Nico Rosberg also never tires of talking about these mind games today," Schumacher added. "That shows what this year has done to the two of them."
Why Ferrari’s 2026 turnaround has fuelled the hierarchy debate

Schumacher’s warning lands amid growing paddock debate over whether Ferrari must establish a clear pecking order after its drivers clashed twice in three rounds across Mexico City and Las Vegas. After 1996 World Champion Damon Hill urged Maranello on social media to back Hamilton outright as its lead driver, Hamilton pushed back directly in Nevada.

"I've never asked to be number one. I genuinely haven't ever asked," Hamilton told reporters. Still, he conceded that earlier in 2026 - when his victory at the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix put him 40 points ahead of Leclerc as Kimi Antonelli’s closest challenger - team support at rounds such as Zandvoort could have helped Ferrari take on Mercedes, adding that team-mates colliding "should just never happen".

The competitive swing inside Ferrari helps explain why nerves are frayed. After trailing Leclerc heavily in his debut red campaign in 2025 (156 points to 242), Hamilton enters the final two rounds of his second Ferrari season 17 points ahead of his team-mate (267 to 250).

Both drivers hold one grand prix win apiece in 2026 - Hamilton in Barcelona and Leclerc at Silverstone - with Hamilton edging podiums seven to six and claiming Ferrari’s lone pole position in Mexico City, while Leclerc retains a 13–eight qualifying edge across 21 shared rounds.

Leclerc accepted full responsibility for his Las Vegas penalty and admitted feeling "quite embarrassed for the team", while Hamilton maintained he had been focused solely on catching McLaren rather than fighting the sister car.

With the Qatar Grand Prix getting under way on Friday (27-29 November) ahead of next week’s finale in Abu Dhabi (4-6 December), Ferrari has little time left to prove its star pairing can coexist without tearing each other’s races apart.

items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen said he feels uncomfortable about the Qatar and Abu Dhabi double-header and would rather stay at home, speaking to Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘坦言，在卡塔尔与阿布扎比两站前，他“宁愿待在家里”。
维斯塔潘在接受荷兰《电讯报》采访时，毫不掩饰自己对F1中东双赛的不适。
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术解析与比赛分析。
F1围场抵达多哈，迎来2026赛季倒数第二站，但维斯塔潘并不掩饰这趟行程让他感到不轻松。
这位四届世界冠军在接受荷兰媒体《电讯报》采访时，对在地区敌对行动持续期间完成卡塔尔和阿布扎比23站赛历一事给出了直率的评价。
“我对此感到安心吗？不，我宁愿待在家里，”维斯塔潘说。“但我们得到了某些保证，因此我们必须假定这些保证是真的。明知周边国家仍可能有火箭飞过头顶还要去那里，这并不令人愉快。但不管怎样，我们还是要去的。”
由于中东冲突，F1直接取消了4月的沙特阿拉伯大奖赛，并将巴林站改到10月的马来西亚雪邦国际赛道举行——维斯塔潘随后在那里从杆位夺冠。数月来，官员一直让意大利伊莫拉赛道待命，作为收官战的低温备选方案，直到11月10日全部11支车队都支持在海湾地区完成赛历后，才撤回了这些备用计划。
同一天，国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆在Instagram上发文，宣布该管理机构已为这两个场地做好准备。
“我们已做好充分准备，并承诺呈现两个精彩的大奖赛周末以及F1锦标赛的盛大收官，”本·苏拉耶姆写道，并补充说官员们“正与合作伙伴密切协作，确保为车手、车队和车迷做好一切安排”。
在围场内，车手们过去一个月里的语气明显不同。在10月的美国大奖赛之前，大奖赛车手协会理事卡洛斯·塞恩斯公开质疑锦标赛的确定性，对记者表示：“他们似乎非常确信比赛会继续进行。就我个人而言，我并不这么认为，”同时敦促所有人“保持警惕，并对任何情况做出反应”。
相比之下，同为大奖赛车手协会理事的乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯对英国媒体表示，尽管有官方旅行警告，他“毫不犹豫”前往卡塔尔和阿联酋，而迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯则表示，他相信F1高层不会让锦标赛约2000名随行工作人员置身险境。
一旦赛车在周五驶上卢赛尔国际赛道进行练习（11月27日至29日），随后赛季在阿布扎比收官（12月4日至6日），维斯塔潘仍有大量需要捍卫的东西。
尽管20岁的基米·安东内利在墨西哥城锁定了车手总冠军，梅赛德斯也在圣保罗拿下了第九个车队总冠军，但红牛赛季末的强势反弹让维斯塔潘连续九场比赛登上领奖台——包括最近六场比赛中的四场胜利。
刚刚在拉斯维加斯那场出现352次超车的惊险大战中获胜后，维斯塔潘以304分位居积分榜第二，在剩余50个车手积分的情况下，领先刘易斯·汉密尔顿（267分）37分，领先拉塞尔和诺里斯（各264分）40分。关键的是，红牛在车队积分榜上以440比431领先迈凯伦、位居第三——这关系到数百万美元的奖金分成——在还剩86个车队积分的情况下，这一优势依然极其微弱。
卡塔尔站本身在2026年取消了冲刺赛赛制，但倍耐力和国际汽联周三又增加了一个新的策略变数：在周日57圈的大奖赛中，每套轮胎最多使用27圈——这保证了比赛至少需要两次进站。维斯塔潘或许更愿意在11月底待在别处，但红牛的车队排名仍未确定，他几乎没有时间东张西望，只能专注于前方的道路。
detailEn: Max Verstappen admits he would “rather stay at home” ahead of Qatar and Abu Dhabi
Speaking to Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf, Max Verstappen made no secret of his discomfort ahead of Formula 1’s Middle East double-header
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Formula 1’s paddock is touching down in Doha for the penultimate round of the 2026 championship, yet Max Verstappen is not pretending the trip sits easily with him.
Speaking to Dutch outlet De Telegraaf, the four-time world champion delivered a blunt assessment of finishing the 23-race calendar in Qatar and Abu Dhabi amid ongoing regional hostilities.

"Do I feel comfortable with it? No, I'd rather stay at home," Verstappen said. "But we've been given certain guarantees, and therefore we have to assume they're true. It's not exactly pleasant to go somewhere knowing that rockets can still fly over your head in the surrounding countries. But, anyway, we're going."

F1 cancelled April’s Saudi Arabian Grand Prix outright and relocated the Bahrain round to Malaysia’s Sepang International Circuit in October - a race Verstappen went on to win from pole - due to the conflict in the Middle East. For months, officials kept Italy’s Imola circuit on standby as a cold-weather contingency for the finale, only to stand down those backup plans on 10 November once all 11 teams backed completing the calendar in the Gulf.
Writing on Instagram the same day, FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem declared the governing body ready for both venues.

"We are fully prepared and committed to delivering two outstanding grand prix weekends and a spectacular conclusion to the [F1 championship]," Ben Sulayem wrote, adding that officials are "working closely with our partners to ensure everything is in place for our drivers, teams and fans".

Inside the paddock, drivers have struck noticeably different tones over the past month. Ahead of October’s United States Grand Prix, Grand Prix Drivers’ Association director Carlos Sainz openly questioned the championship’s certainty, telling reporters: "They seem very convinced that it's going to go ahead. On my personal side, I'm not," while urging everyone to "stay diligent, and reactive to whatever happens".

By contrast, fellow GPDA director George Russell told British media in Las Vegas that he has "no hesitation" in travelling to Qatar and the United Arab Emirates despite official travel warnings, while McLaren’s Lando Norris said he trusts F1 bosses would not place the championship’s roughly 2,000 travelling staff in harm’s way.
Once cars roll out for Friday practice at the Losail International Circuit (27-29 November) before the season closes in Abu Dhabi (4-6 December), Verstappen still has plenty to protect.

Although 20-year-old Kimi Antonelli wrapped up the drivers’ title in Mexico City and Mercedes sealed its ninth constructors’ crown in Sao Paulo, Red Bull’s late-season turnaround has put Verstappen on a nine-race podium streak - including four victories in his last six outings.

Fresh off winning Las Vegas’s 352-overtake thriller, Verstappen sits second in the standings on 304 points, holding a 37-point advantage over Lewis Hamilton (267) and 40 over Russell and Norris (264 apiece) with 50 driver points remaining. Crucially, Red Bull’s 440–431 edge over McLaren for third in the constructors’ standings - worth millions in prize payouts - remains razor-thin with 86 team points still on the board.

Qatar itself drops its sprint format for 2026, yet Pirelli and the FIA added a fresh strategic wrinkle on Wednesday by mandating a 27-lap maximum stint length per tyre set across Sunday’s 57-lap Grand Prix - guaranteeing a minimum two-stop contest. Verstappen may have preferred spending late November elsewhere, but with Red Bull’s constructors’ finish still on the line, he will have little time to look anywhere except the road ahead.

detailZh: FIA文件揭示了红牛赛车在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上赢得胜利的空气动力学更新
F1技术周报和FIA文档9详细说明了红牛赛车降低俯冲平面和侧箱修复如何帮助维斯塔潘赢得拉斯维加斯胜利
对于红牛车迷来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析
马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上的胜利就像一场高速的电池部署下的象棋比赛，但赢得比赛的基石却是一个更加安静的空气动力学修复。
正如Formula1.com的Tech Weekly撰稿人马克·休斯和乔治奥·皮奥拉所指出的，红牛在内华达州对前翼端板进行了细微的调整，同时对其侧箱进行了持续的重构——优化从车鼻到地板的气流，为维斯塔潘提供一辆能够在50个激烈、尾流密集的回合中生存下来的赛车。
官方FIA文件9（汽车展示提交，发布于11月19日）展示了红牛如何与竞争对手形成鲜明对比。梅赛德斯削减了后翼翼尖，修剪了后视镜支架，并缩小了发动机罩出口以减少阻力，而法拉利优化了其前地板以提高Strip效率。相比之下，红牛提交了一个单独的更新，严格归类于性能——局部负载：前翼端板下沉平面的重新定位。
“为了更好地保护前翼端板脚部以及下游表面的气流稳定性，下沉平面已被降低并减少了弦长，”红牛在其FIA提交中写道。
为什么在2026年规则下，一个小小的翼尖如此重要。
红牛车队在去年九月的巴库重大升级中最后一次修改了其前翼端板。对于拉斯维加斯站，工程师们将下沉平面降低到垂直端板的下方，并将其长度修剪成紧凑的形状，这与姐妹车队小红牛已经采用的解决方案非常相似。
尽管视觉上改动不大，但下沉平面有三个重要的功能。除了增加前轴下压力外，它还能消除尖端涡流，这些涡流会加速前轮胎尾流的湍流，同时将流经车轮顶部的气流从侧面绕过的空气分开 - 将更干净的气流输送到车身两侧。
同样重要的是，在2026年的主动空气动力学法规下，休斯和皮奥拉指出，修改后的翼尖在主前翼襟翼旋转时，在直线和转弯模式之间急剧切换时稳定气流。
这次前端的调整并非孤立发生。在巴库，红牛车队引入了更高、更瘦的侧箱，以及修改后的地板和扩散器。四周后在墨西哥城（FIA文件12，10月30日），工程师们修改了侧箱与地板的分割线 - 将巴库之前的规格中弯曲的下车身部分移植到更高的巴库上箱，以封闭地板边缘通道，并在散热器进气口下方恢复局部负载，同时保持稳定性。
在圣保罗和拉斯维加斯赛道上保持不变，那些混合式下侧翼板也揭示了红牛早期头疼的问题：在底盘内部增加了内部结构锥，据信可以防止面板在重力的空气动力学负载下变形。
将练习中的挫败感转化为连续七个领奖台
在内华达州验证新的前翼端板变得混乱。雨洗掉了周四FP1和FP2有意义的测试，迫使红牛依赖干燥的FP3比较 - 包括伊萨克·哈德贾在练习中更换中段翼片 - 在对两辆车的资格赛和比赛进行降低俯冲平面之前。维斯塔潘甚至表示，从巴西带来的“奇怪的问题”在最后练习中让他不满意，坚持认为问题超出了常规平衡。
然而，红牛在预赛最后的设置调整在关键时刻解锁了这套方案。维斯塔潘在Q3中跑出第二快的圈速 - 比基米·安东内利慢0.258秒 - 通过梅赛德斯冠军的五处引擎处罚继承了杆位，并且挡住了梅赛德斯和麦克拉伦的挑战，以0.639秒的优势击败了兰多·诺里斯。
更广泛的趋势不言而喻。自从红牛在巴库建立了基金会以来，维斯塔潘在连续七个大奖赛中都完成了领奖台，并收集了他所有的2026年胜利——这使他以304分的成绩排名第二，同时使红牛在车队积分榜上领先于麦克拉伦9分（440比431），在前往卡塔尔之前，红牛以9分的优势排在第三位。
detailEn: FIA filings reveal the Red Bull aero update behind Max Verstappen’s Las Vegas GP win
F1 Tech Weekly and FIA Doc 9 detail how Red Bull's lowered dive-plane and sidepod fixes aided Verstappen's Vegas win
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Max Verstappen’s Las Vegas Grand Prix victory played out like a high-speed chess match on battery deployment, yet the race-winning foundation rested on a much quieter aerodynamic fix.

As Formula1.com’s Tech Weekly contributors Mark Hughes and Giorgio Piola highlighted, Red Bull paired a subtle front wing endplate tweak in Nevada with an ongoing sidepod rework - refining airflow from nose to floor to give Verstappen a car capable of surviving 50 intense, slipstream-heavy laps.

Official FIA Document 9 (Car Presentation Submissions, issued 19 November) shows how sharply Red Bull diverged from its rivals. Mercedes stripped rear wing winglets, trimmed mirror stays, and narrowed its engine-cover exit to slash drag, while Ferrari optimised its front floorboard for Strip efficiency. Red Bull, by contrast, filed a single update categorised strictly under Performance – Local Load: a repositioned front wing endplate dive-plane.

"In order to better protect the flow stability of the front wing endplate footplate as well as surfaces downstream, the dive-plane has been lowered and reduced in chord length," Red Bull wrote in its FIA submission.
Why one small winglet matters under 2026 rules

Red Bull had last revised its front wing endplates during September’s major Baku upgrade. For Las Vegas, engineers dropped the dive-plane lower down the vertical endplate and trimmed its length into a compact shape closely mirroring the solution already run by sister team Racing Bulls.

Though modest visually, the dive-plane performs three important jobs. Beyond adding front-axle downforce, it sheds tip vortices that accelerate turbulent front-tyre wake outward while splitting airflow travelling over the top of the wheel from air skirting its side - feeding cleaner flow down the car’s flanks.

Just as importantly under 2026’s active-aerodynamics regulations, Hughes and Piola noted the revised winglet stabilises airflow during the abrupt shift between straight-line and cornering modes whenever the main front wing flaps rotate.

That front-end reset did not happen in isolation. In Baku, Red Bull introduced taller, slimmer sidepods alongside a revised floor and diffuser. Four weeks later in Mexico City (FIA Document 12, 30 October), engineers modified the sidepod-to-floor split line - grafting the curved lower bodywork from the pre-Baku specification onto the taller Baku upper pod to close off the floor-edge channel and recover local load beneath the radiator inlet while preserving stability.

Run unchanged through Sao Paulo and Las Vegas, those hybrid lower sidepods also revealed a clue to Red Bull’s earlier headaches: internal structural cones added inside the lower bodywork, believed to stop the panels from deforming under heavy aerodynamic load.
Turning practice frustration into seven straight podiums

Validating the new front wing endplate in Nevada proved messy. Rain wiped out meaningful Thursday running across FP1 and FP2, forcing Red Bull to lean on dry FP3 comparisons - including a mid-session wing swap for Isack Hadjar - before committing to the lowered dive-plane on both cars for qualifying and the race. Verstappen even flagged "weird issues" carried over from Brazil that left him dissatisfied through final practice, insisting the trouble went beyond routine balance.

Still, Red Bull’s late pre-qualifying set-up adjustments unlocked the package when it counted. Verstappen clocked the second-fastest lap in Q3 - 0.258 seconds behind Kimi Antonelli - inherited pole via the Mercedes champion’s five-place engine penalty, and fended off both Mercedes and McLaren to beat Lando Norris by 0.639s.

The broader trend speaks for itself. Since Red Bull introduced its Baku foundation, Verstappen has finished on the podium in seven consecutive grands prix and collected all four of his 2026 victories - lifting him to 304 points in second overall while keeping Red Bull nine points clear of McLaren (440 to 431) for third in the constructors’ standings heading into Qatar.

乔利恩·帕尔默批评法拉利车手在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第38圈的冲突中“完全无视车队”
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与赛后反应。
在2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，22名车手完成了创纪录的352次超车，且大多干净利落，但F1最激烈的队内冲突仍属于法拉利。
第38圈，夏尔·勒克莱尔在7号弯内线插入刘易斯·汉密尔顿，两人正争夺第六名——这次碰撞导致他的队友打转，勒克莱尔因此被罚10秒，并引发F1 TV评论员乔利恩·帕尔默在赛后直言不讳的评判。
当被问及法拉利搭档为何再次发生冲突时，帕尔默毫不掩饰自己的看法。
“车手的自尊心，”帕尔默说。“我的意思是，夏尔显然是挑衅的一方；弗雷德（瓦塞尔）非常坚持责任在谁。我在第10圈左右就说过，当时所有赛车都在拼命争夺——那是什么，352次超车——我们还在说车手们能把比赛保持干净有多好。
“然后我就想，‘你知道谁不会保持干净吗？不知怎么的，唯一一次接触就会发生在两辆法拉利之间。’果不其然，确实如此。为什么？因为总是这样。他们彼此之间的竞争比跟其他任何人都更激烈。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利；夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利
在复盘7号弯的回放时，帕尔默指出，虽然汉密尔顿在内线留出的空间很紧，但勒克莱尔在刚刚收到车队直接指令后几秒钟就去冒险，完全没有道理。
“考虑到他几个弯之前刚刚被法拉利警告过，在那个弯道这么做是不必要的风险，”帕尔默说。
“而且他们完全无视车队。我有点为弗雷德感到难过，因为你就能看到他；他已经被管理这两位车手搞得精疲力竭。我不知道接下来会怎样。你知道，你还能再多说什么呢？”
帕尔默的同情是在法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔于赛道边接受了一次明显恼怒的采访之后表达的。三周前在墨西哥城，勒克莱尔因在第一圈切过汉密尔顿而被罚时五秒，两人此前已经进行过严肃的澄清谈话，而瓦塞尔这次没有拐弯抹角。
“老实说，我的立场是，这又一次超出了可接受的范围，”瓦塞尔对F1电视台说。“我在墨西哥之后说了完全一样的话，但这是缺乏尊重——是对车队、对赞助商缺乏尊重，但主要是对在家里工作的人们缺乏尊重。我们在五个弯之前就把消息传递给了夏尔，对我来说这是一个职业性的错误。”
到周二，瓦塞尔的沮丧进一步加深。在卡塔尔站前谈及此事的影响时，他承认内部压力“现在比18个月前大得多”，并补充说：“最近，他们之间的状况已经变得难以管理。”
法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿
赛道上的代价令人痛心。排位赛仅列第10和第11后，两辆法拉利在第二阶段（stint）凭借足以登上领奖台的速度追至距领先者三秒以内——结果第38圈的纠缠让汉密尔顿（此前还因避让兰多·诺里斯被罚10秒）落到第七，勒克莱尔落到第十，仅收获可怜的七个积分。汉密尔顿拒绝公开加码指责，称争议“交由车队处理”，并希望“他们最终能解决”。
法拉利在车队积分榜上仍以517分对440分、领先红牛77分稳居第二，剩余卡塔尔和阿布扎比两站；车手榜上汉密尔顿以267分对250分领先勒克莱尔17分，位列第三。
detailEn: Fred Vasseur is running out of answers at Ferrari, says Jolyon Palmer
Jolyon Palmer criticises Ferrari's drivers for a "complete disregard for the team" after their Lap 38 Las Vegas GP clash
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
In a 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix where 22 drivers traded a record 352 overtakes largely cleanly, Formula 1’s fiercest intra-team blowup still belonged to Ferrari.

On Lap 38, Charles Leclerc dived down the inside of Lewis Hamilton at Turn 7 while battling over sixth place - tipping his team-mate into a spin, drawing a 10-second time penalty, and sparking a blunt post-race verdict from F1 TV analyst Jolyon Palmer.
Asked why Ferrari’s pairing had come to blows yet again, Palmer did not hold back with his verdict.

"Egos of drivers," Palmer said. "I mean, Charles clearly the aggressor there; Fred is pretty adamant where the blame lies. I said it on about Lap 10, when all the cars were fighting tooth and nail - what was it, 352 passes - and we were saying how good are the drivers being able to keep it clean.

"And I just thought, 'You know who's not going to keep it clean? Somehow the one bit of contact will be between the two Ferraris.' And lo and behold, it does. Why? Because it always is. They race each other harder than they race anyone else."
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Charles Leclerc, Ferrari
Reviewing the Turn 7 replay, Palmer noted that while Hamilton left tight room on the inside, Leclerc had no business gambling moments after receiving a direct team instruction.
"Given he's just been warned by Ferrari a few corners before, it's an unnecessary risk to do that in that corner," Palmer said.

"And they've got a complete disregard for the team. I feel a bit sorry for Fred because you just see him; he's worn out by trying to manage these two drivers. And I don't know what's next. You know, what more do you have to say?"

Palmer’s sympathy followed a visibly exasperated trackside interview from Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur. Having already held stern clear-the-air talks after Leclerc took a five-second penalty for cutting across Hamilton on Lap 1 in Mexico City three weeks earlier, Vasseur did not mince words.

"Honestly, my position is that once again, it's more than unacceptable," Vasseur told F1 TV. "I had exactly the same word after Mexico, but it's a lack of respect - it's a lack of respect for the team, for the sponsors, but mainly for the people working at home. We passed the message to Charles five corners before, and for me it's a professional mistake."

By Tuesday, Vasseur’s frustration had hardened further. Addressing the fallout ahead of Qatar, he admitted the internal pressure is "much worse now than it was 18 months ago", adding: "Lately, the situation between them has become unmanageable."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

The on-track cost stung deeply. After qualifying 10th and 11th, both Ferraris climbed within three seconds of the race lead during the second stint with podium-worthy pace - only for the Lap 38 tangle to leave Hamilton seventh (having also served an earlier 10-second penalty avoiding Lando Norris) and Leclerc 10th for a meagre seven-point haul. Hamilton declined to pile on publicly, saying the dispute was "for the team to deal with" and hoping "they'll eventually figure it out".

Ferrari still holds a comfortable 77-point buffer over Red Bull for second in the constructors’ standings (517 to 440) with Qatar and Abu Dhabi remaining, while Hamilton leads Leclerc by 17 points (267 to 250) in third overall.

items.originalTitle: Williams and Alpine breached F1's cost cap in 2025
items.summaryEn: The Williams and Alpine Formula 1 teams both breached the FIA's cost cap rules in 2025. Williams committed a minor overspend breach as well as a procedural breach, while Alpine was found to have committed a procedural breach only; both teams face financial penalties, and Williams also faces a sporting penalty.
detailZh: 威廉姆斯和阿尔派两支F1车队在2025年均违反了国际汽联的成本上限规则。
威廉姆斯存在轻微超支违规以及程序性违规，而阿尔派仅被认定存在程序性违规。
两队都将面临罚款，威廉姆斯还将受到竞技处罚。
五家动力单元制造商在2025年均被认定合规。
2025年，车队成本上限为1.35亿美元，引擎制造商为1.3亿美元，另加通胀调整。
威廉姆斯的违规属于“轻微超支违规”，即低于2025年成本上限的5%。
该车队被认定超出成本上限62.7万英镑，占成本上限的0.48%。
该车队于11月23日与国际汽联签订了接受违规协议。
作为《预算上限违规协议》（ABA）的一部分，国际汽联成本上限管理机构承认威廉姆斯车队“以合作的态度和诚信的精神行事”；并没有指控威廉姆斯车队有意寻求违反成本上限。
国际汽联认定，威廉姆斯车队的违规源于对规则的误解。
该车队的超支是由于程序性违规，即未能提交准确的财务报告。由于威廉姆斯在成本排除和调整方式上的错误，导致其超支。
作为处罚的一部分，该车队必须在裁决后30天内向国际汽联支付罚款（如未按时支付，则需支付利息）。
该车队还将从《阿布扎比协议》签署之日起的12个月内（至2027年11月23日），被扣减1.5%的风洞测试时间和计算流体力学（CFD）测试时间。
该车队于周三（11月25日）发布声明，承认了上述违规行为。
声明称：“此次违规涉及我们为调整公司结构而产生的行政成本。
“我们曾认为这些成本不在预算帽范围内。经与国际汽联（FIA）沟通后，我们已同意按照他们的解释解决此事，即这些成本本应计入预算帽。”
国际汽联已注意到威廉姆斯并未获得任何体育或经济优势，我们也从未寻求过此类优势。国际汽联还注意到，我们在整个审查过程中始终以合作和善意的态度行事。
诚信是威廉姆斯立身之本的核心，我们现在可以了结此案，继续专注于我们的未来。
我们一直是并且将继续是成本上限的坚定支持者，而成本上限自然需要准确的监管才能有效。
成本上限管理机构认定，与威廉姆斯一样，阿尔派恩以善意态度予以配合，并未寻求违反成本上限，也未从中寻求任何优势。
阿尔派 的违规属于程序性违规，原因是其 2025 年报告中的“不准确之处”。
该车队承认，它未计入与营销活动相关的成本、非 F1 活动成本、归属于人力资源活动的成本以及员工奖金成本。
此外，该车队在获得税收抵免或财务收入后，未对成本作出充分调整，也未就库存作出充分调整。
阿尔派 必须在 12 月 12 日前支付一笔财务罚款，因为它已于 11 月 11 日签署了一份 协议。
阿尔派 在11月25日发布声明称，尊重“成本上限管理部门的调查结果”。
“车队接受其在不知情的情况下违反了程序性规定，这是由于全年报告中与豁免和调整相关的成本文件存在不准确之处。”
声明补充说：“报告中的错误和不准确之处具体涉及非体育和运营成本。”随后详细列出了上述自身违规情况。
声明继续写道：“车队还要感谢成本上限管理部门和国际汽联在整个过程中的勤勉与理解。”
“财务规则仍然相对较新、不断演变且复杂，其中一些豁免和调整项可由各车队自行解读。车队认可其在整个业务范围内需要做出的集体努力，并认识到未来可以在哪些方面进行改进。”
detailEn: The Williams and Alpine Formula 1 teams both breached the FIA's cost cap rules in 2025.
Williams committed a minor spending breach as well as a procedural breach, while Alpine was found to have committed a procedural breach only.
Both teams face financial penalties, and Williams also faces a sporting penalty.
All five power unit manufacturers were found to be in compliance for 2025.
In 2025, the cost cap was $135million for teams and $130m for engine manufacturers, plus inflation.
Williams's breach was a "minor overspend breach", which is less than 5% of the cost cap for 2025.
The team was found to have breached the cost cap by £627,000 or 0.48% of the cost cap.
The team entered an ABA - accepted breach agreement - with the FIA on November 23.

As part of the ABA, the FIA's cost cap administration acknowledged that Williams "acted cooperatively and in a spirit of good faith"; there is no accusation that Williams sought to breach the cost cap willingly.
The FIA found that Williams's breach arose from a misinterpretation of the rules.
The team's overspend was due to a procedural breach in which it failed to file accurate financial reports. As a result of errors in how Williams excluded and adjusted its costs, it overspent.
As part of its punishment, the team will have to pay a financial penalty to the FIA within 30 days of the decision (with interest due if it doesn't do so on time).
The team will also receive a 1.5% subtraction from its windtunnel testing time and CFD testing time for 12 months from the date of the ABA being executed (until November 23, 2027).
The team released a statement on Wednesday (November 25) that acknowledged the above breaches.
It said: "The breach relates to administrative costs we incurred making changes to our company structure.
"We believed these costs fell outside of the cap. Following discussions with the FIA, we have agreed to resolve the matter in line with their interpretation that the costs should have been in cap.

"The FIA has noted that Williams did not gain any sporting or financial advantage, and nor did we ever seek to. It has also noted that we acted cooperatively and in good faith throughout the review process.
"Integrity is central to what Williams stands for and we can now close this case and remain focused on our future.
"We have always been and will continue to be strong supporters of the cost cap, which naturally requires accurate policing to be effective."
The cost cap administration found that, like Williams, Alpine had cooperated in good faith and did not seek to breach the cost cap, nor gain any advantage from doing so.
Alpine's breach was procedural and due to "inaccuracies" in its reporting for 2025.
The team accepted that it had excluded costs relating to its marketing activities, non-F1 activities, costs attributable to HR activities, and employee bonus costs.
Furthermore, the team had not made sufficient adjustments to its costs after receiving tax credits or finance income, nor had it made sufficient adjustments regarding inventory.
Alpine will have to pay a financial penalty by December 12 as it entered an ABA on November 11.
Alpine released a statement on November 25 that said it respected "the findings of the cost cap administration".
"The team accepts that it unknowingly committed a procedural breach, which is a result of inaccuracies in the full year reporting documentation for costs related to exclusions and adjustments.
"The errors and inaccuracies in the reporting were specifically related to non-sporting and operational costs," it added, before detailing its own breaches as above.
"The team would also like to express its thanks to both the CCA and FIA, for its diligence and understanding throughout the entire process," the statement continued.

"The financial regulations are still relatively new, constantly evolving and complex, with some exclusions and adjustments being open to each team’s interpretation. The team acknowledges the collective efforts it needs to make across the business and recognises where improvements can be made in future."
